tasks.text: After years of struggle, Sarah finally decided to cease smoking. She remembered trying to quit before: she once stopped smoking for a month, then gave up under stress. This time she chose a different approach. She would not abandon her goal so easily. Whenever she felt the urge, she stopped to think about her health instead of lighting a cigarette. Her doctor advised her to resume light exercise, which helped her tolerate the cravings. At times she wanted to postpone the whole plan, but she persisted. She would often ponder her reasons late at night, trying to envisage a healthier future. Six months later, she no longer dreads social events where people smoke. She simply refrains, calmly and without struggle.

tasks.text: Last month, a well-known businessman appeared in court, accused of tax fraud. During the trial, the prosecutor presented documents that seemed to prove the accusation. However, the businessman denied hiding any income and insisted on his innocence. His lawyer worked hard to justify each transaction and defend his client's reputation. Several witnesses were called to testify, and their statements often contradicted each other. After three days, the jury delivered its verdict: not guilty. Although the prosecutor still disputes the decision and plans to appeal, the judge closed the case for now. Outside the court, the businessman told reporters that he never doubted the outcome, since the truth, in his words, always comes out eventually.
